evals.prompt: can you check this proof and tell me what the reviewers want changed? group it by page pls <review-url>
evals.expected_output: A per-page list of unresolved comments on the latest version, with author and comment text, sourced from the script output.

evals.prompt: We uploaded a new version of this proof yesterday: <review-url> — which comments from the previous version look addressed and which are still open?
evals.expected_output: Comments from version N-1 split into addressed (resolved or replied as fixed) and still open, noting any that recur on version N.

evals.prompt: Who has signed off on <review-url> and is anything blocking approval?
evals.expected_output: Each reviewer's decision on the latest version plus the unresolved comments that block approval.

evals.prompt: walk me through how this proof is laid out, page by page, so I know what was captured: <review-url>
evals.expected_output: Page-by-page description in the SKILL.md format: every capture with device, width@dpr and extent; a sitemap diagram, if any, with its page IDs and highlighted nodes; state captures (a tab, accordion or menu open) told apart by their changedFrom box; a menu-only capture as viewport; routes where found in the code; groups and same-page links; a Sticky line; comments per page.
